# verygood chocolate Sydney

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verygood_syd/
Made-to-order cakes and treats with chocolatier-grade couverture chocolate. Pickup in Melrose Park, Sydney. Sydney time: Wednesday & Friday 09:00–20:00 · Saturday & Sunday 09:00–13:00. No general pickup on Monday, Tuesday or Thursday. Requests are confirmed by our team after availability and payment checks.
You may arrange an Uber, DiDi or another driver to collect your order. Please contact us in advance to agree on the handover time. Handover outside general pickup hours requires prior operator approval and cannot be selected online. You arrange and pay for the driver.

## Chocolate
- Chocolate Mochi: Six Chocolate Mochi flavours in Sydney: choose singles or build a four-piece gift box with free box packaging. Pickup in Melrose Park. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/chocolates/chocolate-mochi
  - Original Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 8.00.
  - Strawberry Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 10.00.
  - Green Grape Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 9.50.
  - Mandarin Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 9.00.
  - Banana Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 9.00.
  - Ang-Butter Pavé Chocolate · 1 piece (single): AUD 8.50.
Choose exactly four pieces for each gift box: the price is the sum of the selected singles and box packaging is free. Order several identical boxes, different box selections, or mixed singles. Optional individual packaging for singles is AUD 0.50 per piece; no free gift box applies to singles.
Minimum 24 hours preparation.
Original: 80g. Fruit and butter & red bean: at least 85g each; fruit weight varies.
Keep refrigerated. Best enjoyed on the day. Recommended refrigerated storage: up to 3 days.
Contains milk and soy. Made in a facility that also handles almonds, wheat, eggs, sesame and peanuts.
